## University policies

<details class="syl-policy">
<summary>Academic integrity</summary>

The expectations and academic standards in the
[Student Academic Code (3C2)](https://www.siue.edu/policies/table-of-contents/3c2.shtml)
apply to all courses at the University, regardless of modality. Plagiarism (the
use of another person's words or ideas without credit) and cheating will not be
tolerated and may lead to failure on an assignment, in the class, or dismissal
from the University, per the
[SIUE academic dishonesty policy (3C1)](https://www.siue.edu/policies/table-of-contents/3c1.shtml).
Cite your data sources and collaborators.

</details>

<details class="syl-policy">
<summary>Diversity and inclusion</summary>

SIUE is committed to respecting everyone's dignity at all times. Our classroom
must be a place where students and instructors feel safe and supported. Systems
of oppression permeate our institutions and our classrooms; all students and
instructors share responsibility for affirming inclusion, equity, and social
justice. Racism, sexism, classism, ableism, heterosexism, xenophobia, and other
social pathologies will not be tolerated, and violations will be enforced in
line with the SIUE Student Conduct Code. The
[Kimmel Belonging and Engagement Hub](https://www.siue.edu/kimmel-hub/) is a
resource for students.

</details>

<details class="syl-policy">
<summary>Pregnancy and newly parenting</summary>

This course follows
[SIUE's Newly Parenting Policy (3C15)](https://www.siue.edu/policies/table-of-contents/3c15.shtml).
Students may request accommodations through the Office of Equal Opportunity,
Access, and Title IX Coordination ([EOA](https://www.siue.edu/eoa/)).

</details>

<details class="syl-policy">
<summary>Technology and privacy</summary>

This course uses Blackboard; review the
[Anthology Blackboard Privacy Statement](https://www.anthology.com/privacy-statement)
for how your data is handled. The course also uses GitHub; review GitHub's
privacy policy before creating an account.

</details>

<details class="syl-policy">
<summary>Recordings of class content</summary>

Any recordings of class sessions are for the educational use of students
enrolled in this course only. Students may not copy, share, or distribute
recordings without the written permission of the instructor. Office hours are
not recorded, so that conversations about grades, accommodations, or personal
circumstances stay private.

</details>

<details class="syl-policy">
<summary>Subject to change</summary>

All material, assignments, and deadlines are subject to change with prior
notice. Watch the course announcements and Blackboard regularly. This page is
the live version of the syllabus; if a printed copy and this page disagree, this
page is correct.

</details>
